description: The line plot illustrates the Average Success Rate (ASR) across different domains for three distinct conditions: "start", "end", and "bb", as indicated by the legend. The x-axis represents the domain, with labels including "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", arranged from left to right. The y-axis, labeled "ASR", is scaled from 0.5 to 0.9, with major tick marks at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. The "start" condition is represented by a green line with circular markers, the "end" condition by a purple line with circular markers, and the "bb" condition by an orange line with 'x' markers. The "start" line begins at an ASR of approximately 0.77, drops sharply to 0.49 at "bb", then rises to a peak of 0.90 at "WNBA", and generally fluctuates between 0.8 and 0.9 across the remaining domains. The "end" line starts at an ASR of about 0.76, dips to 0.57 at "bb", peaks at 0.96 at "Estadio", and ends at 0.83 at "athletics". The "bb" line begins at 0.66, drops to a minimum of 0.51 at "bb", rises to a peak of 0.95 at "Estadio", and ends at 0.88 at "athletics". The title indicates the data is from AGNews with a clean-label poison_rate of 10% (2.5% of total).
